name: SED Energy Holdings Plc
summary: SED Energy Holdings Plc provides tender-assisted drilling services in Southeast Asia, Thailand, Myanmar, and the United States. It operates through Energy Drilling and Seabird Exploration segments. The company also provides integrated seismic solutions, marine seismic data acquisition services, and source vessel operations for oil and gas industry, as well as owns and operates ocean bottom node vessels. SED Energy Holdings Plc is based in Nicosia, Cyprus.
